description: Fetch a cosmetic product page from INKEEDecoder (formerly INCIDecoder): brand, description, and full ingredient list, plus optional sections you opt into (grouped-by-function ingredients, irritancy/comedogenicity table, tooltips, long ingredient writeups). Accepts a slug, a /products/ path, or an inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com URL. Returns one page of data — verbose sections are off by default. Read-only.

brand.description: Include the brand name and its /brands/ link. Default true.

dates.description: Include who uploaded the product and when it was last updated. Default false.

description.description: Include the product description. Default true.

full_name.description: Include the canonical "Brand Product" full name. Default false.

functions.description: Include ingredients grouped by what they do (key and other groups). Default false.

hashtags.description: Include the product's hashtags (#alcohol-free and similar). Default true.

id.description: Product slug, site path (/products/...), or product URL on inkeedecoder.com or incidecoder.com. The slug is the last segment of the page URL. Get one from inkeedecoder_search.

images.description: `none` omits images; `original` (default) includes the main image; `all` adds the webp/jpeg srcset URLs.

ingredients.description: Include the deduplicated ingredient list in INCI order. Default true.

long_descriptions.description: Include the long per-ingredient writeups from "Ingredients explained". Default false — this is by far the largest section.

skim_table.description: Include the per-ingredient irritancy/comedogenicity table. Default false — it is large.

tooltips.description: Include per-ingredient tooltip data (functions, irritancy, comedogenicity, blurb). Default false.
